description: Election Commission - Mr. Orukanda Liyanage Asanka Sampath Peiris Waselected as the member of the Thalawakele Liadula Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local urban council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a seat that became vacant. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for government bodies.
